headline: KLA Declares Regular Cash Dividend
summary: The KLA Corporation (NASDAQ: KLAC) Board of Directors today declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.23 per share on its common stock, payable on Sept. 1, 2026 to KLA shareholders of record as of the close of business on Aug. 17, 2026.
